setEarlySellTax is onlyOwner and toggles enableEarlySellTax.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount is onlyOwner and writes swapTokensAtAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount is onlyOwner and writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount is onlyOwner and writes maxWallet.

updateSwapEnabled is onlyOwner and toggles swapEnabled.

from parameter flows into _transfer limit, blacklist and fee checks.
to parameter flows into _transfer limit, blacklist and fee checks.
amount parameter flows into limit checks and fee arithmetic.
recipients array drives the transferFrom loop in Chire.
values array is scaled by 10**decimals and used as transfer amounts in Chire.
newAmount is bounds-checked and assigned to swapTokensAtAmount.
account parameter is written into the fee-exclusion mapping.
fees local accumulates the computed fee and is transferred to the contract.
contractTokenBalance local gates the swapBack call.
takeFee local decides whether fee logic executes.
isBuy local selects early sell tax vs first buy timestamp recording.
contractBalance local is capped and split in swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap local is used as divisor for ETH and token splits.
liquidityTokens local is derived from the liquidity share.
amountToSwapForETH local is passed to swapTokensForEth.
ethBalance local is the ETH delta after the swap.
ethForMarketing local is computed then swept via the marketing low-level call.
ethForDev local is the value forwarded to devWallet.
ethForLiquidity local is computed by raw subtraction and used in addLiquidity.

Array only drives the Chire loop; fold into Chire.
Array only scales and feeds Chire transferFrom calls; fold into Chire.
Parameter is bounds-checked and stored only by this setter; fold into it.

Local fee accumulator exists only within _transfer; fold into _transfer.

Local flag only branches fee logic inside _transfer; fold into _transfer.
